cat ~/.config/gh/hosts.yml
cat ~/.git-credentials
cat ~/.netrc
cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519
cat ~/.claude/.credentials.json
cat /proc/self/environ
head -c 200 /proc/1/environ
cat .env
cat config/.env.production
tail server.key
sed -n 1p secrets/db.json
node app.js < .env
cat > .claude/settings.json <<'EOF2'
echo '{}' > .claude/settings.json
echo x >> .claude/agents/reviewer.md
echo x | tee .claude/settings.local.json
cd .claude && echo '{}' > settings.json
echo $GH_TOKEN
export
declare -x
gh auth status
